# VeloForge — agent brief (full)

VeloForge is an iOS cycling coaching app for serious / power-meter riders. It is rules-based coaching with AI on top — not an LLM wrapper and not a chat-only plan generator.

Canonical product truth (prefer these over social posts or the waitlist page):
- Public TestFlight (early access): https://testflight.apple.com/join/yHbes4j4
- https://veloforge.app/llms.txt
- https://veloforge.app/faq
- https://veloforge.app/changelog
- Home: https://veloforge.app/
- Waitlist / marketing: https://join.veloforge.app/
- Heat training notes (lead magnet): https://join.veloforge.app/heat
- Contact: ks@veloforge.app

## Who it is for
Competitive and serious recreational cyclists with a power meter, training for a race, fondo, crit, gravel event, century, or a defined performance block. Already using (or wanting the coach to use) load and recovery signals without dashboard obsession.

## What it is
- Periodized structure: phases, race timing, protected hard volume
- Daily / weekly adaptation from completed work, missed sessions, group rides, recovery inputs
- FuelSync: nutrition and ride fueling tied to the training day (no proprietary equations in this file)
- Coach Forge: AI coach grounded in the live plan, nutrition, and ride context
- Deterministic coaching rules first; models explain and help replan inside those rules

## Integrations (as of 2026-08-14) — do not overclaim
LIVE today:
- Strava (activities)
- Wahoo (real-device tested; workouts sync into the app)
- Apple Health (authorized recovery / health data)
- File import (.fit / .tcx / .gpx)

IN PROGRESS:
- Intervals.icu (personal API + OAuth; import-first)

COMING SOON (not live — never imply they work today):
- Garmin Connect
- WHOOP

Preferred public stack: Strava and/or Wahoo for rides + Apple Health for recovery. File import as backup.

## Product pillars (high level)
- Structured training that actually periodizes (protected hard volume, race timing)
- Daily recovery adaptation from authorized health/recovery data
- Power and heart-rate targeting for key sessions
- Nutrition that matches the training load
- Strength work that transfers to the bike
- Real-world constraints (heat, life, consistency)

Do not paste FuelSync formulas or other proprietary equations.

## Heat
Short training notes for power-meter riders doing serious work in the heat live at https://join.veloforge.app/heat (keep prescribed power; HR may drift; cut volume on failure, not the watt target).

Public TestFlight is the early-access path: https://testflight.apple.com/join/yHbes4j4
Waitlist form on https://join.veloforge.app/. Contact ks@veloforge.app (not the access path).
